data.one_liner: A Flutter widget accepting numeric values with increment and decrement buttons.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TextFormField combined with buttons and logic to handle incrementing and decrementing numerical values. Supports minimum/max limits, step factors, and custom layouts.
use_when: You need a numeric input field with built-in plus and minus buttons.
You want to enforce minimum and maximum value constraints on numeric inputs.
avoid_when: You need standard text input or non-numeric form fields.
You require a slider or complex multi-value picker instead of a stepper field.
strengths: Configurable increment/decrement factors and button layouts.
Built-in support for min/max clamping and integer or double values.
weaknesses: Limited to numeric input stepper use cases.
Requires a TextEditingController for proper operation.
